The '''2009–10 Eredivisie''' was the 54th season of [[Eredivisie]] since its establishment in 1955. [[AZ (football club)|AZ]] were the reigning champions. A total of 18 teams is taking part in the league, consisting of 16 who competed in the previous season and two promoted from the [[2008–09 Eerste Divisie|Eerste Divisie]]. The teams promoted from the Eerste Divisie at the end of the previous season were champions [[VVV-Venlo]] and promotion/relegation play-off winners [[RKC Waalwijk]].

The season started on 31 July 2009 and ended on 2 May 2010. [[FC Twente]] won their first ever Eredivisie title.<ref>{{cite news|first=Louise|last=Taylor|location=[[Rat Verlegh Stadion]], [[Breda]]|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2010/may/02/steve-mcclaren-nac-breda-twente|title=Steve McClaren goes from zero to hero as FC Twente win Dutch title|date=2 May 2010|work=[[The Guardian]]|access-date=4 May 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://soccernet.espn.go.com/report?id=271887&cc=5739|title=First title for Twente|date=2 May 2010|work=[[ESPNsoccernet]]|publisher=[[ESPN]]|access-date=4 May 2010|archive-date=22 June 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110622094411/http://soccernet.espn.go.com/report?id=271887&cc=5739|url-status=dead}}</ref>

As of 2025, this is the last time that none of the [[Big Three (Netherlands)|big three Dutch teams]] have won the title.

==Play-offs==

===European competition===
The teams placed 6th through 9th compete in a play-off tournament for one spot in the [[2010–11 UEFA Europa League#Second qualifying round|second qualifying round]] of the UEFA Europa League 2010–11.

====Semi-finals====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Roda JC]]'''||3–2|[[Heracles Almelo]]||1–1|2–1}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[FC Utrecht]]'''||5–1|[[FC Groningen]]||3–1|2–0}}
{{end}}

====Final====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Roda JC]]||1–6|'''[[FC Utrecht]]'''||0–2|1–4}}
{{end}}

===Relegation===
The 16th and 17th placed teams, along with the teams from [[2009–10 Eerste Divisie|Eerste Divisie]], participate in a play-off for two spots in [[2010–11 Eredivisie]].

====Round 1====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[FC Eindhoven]]'''||4–2|[[AGOVV Apeldoorn]]||1–0|3–2}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Helmond Sport]]'''||3–3 ([[Penalty shootout (association football)|p.]] 5–4)|[[FC Den Bosch]]||1–2|2–1}}
{{end}}

====Round 2====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Eindhoven]]||2–3|'''[[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]'''||1–2|1–1}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Go Ahead Eagles]]'''||2–1|[[SC Cambuur-Leeuwarden|SC Cambuur]]||2–0|0–1}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Zwolle]]||3–5|'''[[SBV Excelsior|Excelsior]]'''||0–1|3–4}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Helmond Sport]]||2–3|'''[[Sparta Rotterdam]]'''||2–1|0–2}}
{{end}}

====Round 3====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Go Ahead Eagles]]||1–3([[extra time|aet]])|'''[[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]'''||1–0|0–3}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[SBV Excelsior|Excelsior]]'''||1–1([[Away goals rule|ag]])|[[Sparta Rotterdam]]||0–0|1–1}}
{{end}}

Willem II and Excelsior will play in 2010–11 Eredivisie.
